File dropzone

Source: R/dropzone.R
shad_dropzone.Rd

A drag-and-drop file picker styled like shadcn. It bridges to Shiny's native file-upload machinery: input$<inputId> is the standard files data frame (name, size, type, datapath), exactly as shiny::fileInput(). Files can be dropped onto the zone or chosen via the browse dialog.

Usage

shad_dropzone(
  inputId,
  label = NULL,
  multiple = FALSE,
  accept = NULL,
  max_size = NULL,
  hint = NULL,
  meta = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id (yields the uploaded-files data frame).

label

Optional label shown above the zone.

multiple

If TRUE, allow selecting several files.

accept

Character vector of accepted types (.csv, text/csv, image/*, …), as in shiny::fileInput().

max_size

Optional per-file size cap in bytes (client-side pre-check; oversize files are rejected inline and never uploaded).

hint

Zone hint text. The default emphasises "Click to browse".

meta

Optional constraints line (e.g. "CSV up to 1 MB").

width

CSS width.

disabled

If TRUE, disable the zone.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A dropzone tag; uploads bind to input$<inputId>.

See also

Other shadshiny flow: shad_number_input(), shad_rating(), shad_step(), shad_stepper(), shad_tree(), shad_tree_item(), update_shad_number_input(), update_shad_rating(), update_shad_stepper(), update_shad_tree()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  shad_dropzone("upload", multiple = TRUE, accept = ".csv",
                meta = "CSV files only")
}
